reviews.review: A fun team-based PvE FPS. This is one of three games devs that i follow on discord. They put out regular updates that substantially improve player QoL and game content. Most importantly they dont double dip on your wallet asking for DLC money. You buy the game, you get all the improvements and features.

(This was written while the game was in Early Access, but all of it remains relevant to my review.)

There's already a bunch of reviews about how fun the game is, so I'll skip to your biggest question: "Is this another unfinished Early Access game?" The answer: not at all.

This game is under the loving care of some amazing developers. Not only is it super fun, but the developers are there every step of the way to make sure things go as smoothly as possible. They listen to player feedback and not ONCE have I seen someone complain about a new update. There's already enough content for an entire game, but Ghost Ship Games continues to add more. Don't let the Early Access tag scare you- this game is here to stay! Thank you, GSG!

Post-Early Access Update: my review stands. The game made it through Early Access smooth as butter, and continues to be enjoyable with new content many months later.

.. make that many years later :)

Like a mix of Left 4 Dead and Helldivers with the destructible terrain of the original Red Faction.  Lots of customization options for weapons and equipment, all unique to each of the 4 classes, and also lots of options for personal cosmetics.  Each class has their own weapons and gear, including a piece of equipment for traversing the terrain.  The driller obviously has drills to quickly chew through rock and stone, the scout has a grappling hook for zipping around quickly, the gunner has a gun that creates ziplines anyone can use, and the engineer has a gun that creates foam platforms to use to reach a vein of ore or as a bridge or as fall protection or even to block access to routes for the enemies.  

The game has lots of action and replayability.  The graphics, while simple, are quite pretty and do an excellent job of conveying the feeling of being underground.  The action is intense and the difficulty levels scale nicely.  The developers have filled the game with so many nice little touches that I don't have time to go  into them all.  It's funny and charming and totally worth your time and money.  I am definitely a space dwarf.

FOR ROCK AND STONE!
